name: Governor's Institutes of Vermont Summer Institutes
description_short: Residential summer programs for Vermont high school students, each on a college campus around the state and each on one subject, such as arts, engineering, math, health and medicine, or weather and climate. Students live in campus dorms for one to two weeks.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund with written notice by June 1. No refund if a student leaves early by choice or for a conduct breach. Prorated refunds if GIV sends a student home under its illness policy or cancels an Institute after it starts.

for_andrew: Eight Institutes, each with its own dates and campus but the same grades, so per the brief this is one listing. City is GIV's Winooski office; the Institutes run in Burlington (5), Castleton, Northfield and Lyndon. Split per campus instead?
Prices left out: the tuition page shows the 2027 sliding scale ($10 to $3,410 short course, $20 to $3,740 long course) and 2026 prices are no longer posted. Not mixed with 2026 dates.
Grades: GIV takes students who are in grades 9 to 11 during the school year when they apply; they attend the summer after.
